title: Monster Speed V3 Step 4 — Fresh responsive viewport session repair
root_cause: The responsive proof reused one Streamlit browser page/session across 390, 768, and 1440. The 390 contract passed, then session/rerun state from the prior viewport contaminated the 768 navigation and temporarily exposed only the default Moneyline market.
patch: Create a fresh Playwright page/Streamlit session for every responsive viewport and for every first-width deployment retry. Apply the same isolation rule to the frozen public Top Picks verifier and permanently guard it.
